_comment: v1.3 Legion Phase 7.3 - Performance baseline for v1.3.0.
Same shape as tests/benchmarks/baseline_v1.0.json so the
bench_tolerance_test can load either one. bench_tolerance_test
defaults to the v1.0 baseline; set FCEUX11_BENCH_BASELINE to
this file to verify against v1.3 instead.
Each benchmark records: name, rom, frames_per_iter, iterations,
and the median total wall-clock time in milliseconds over 5
iterations, measured on the same machine class.
The 1 percent tolerance gate from v1.3 Legion is the ASPIRATIONAL
target. v1.3-v1.5 shipped 2.5 percent. r54 (2026-10-03) raised it
to 5 percent: within a single capture the 5 medians already spread
2.8 percent (156.3-160.7 ms), so 2.5 sat inside this host's noise
band and flaked on unchanged code; a -j 4 ctest run overshoots ~10
percent, which is why CI excludes this test with -LE perf. Run the
gate serially with no concurrent load. Real regressions on this
project have been >100 percent (the pre-r54 baseline), so 5 still
gates. An earlier draft of this note blamed in-suite drift measured
while a cargo build ran concurrently; a clean re-run disproved it.
